**Current**
- He has a partially torn Achilles, found during surgery in May. He is out to start the season. (fact, 2026-10-15, until return, expected Thanksgiving to Christmas; [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=1491), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1937), [09-29](https://youtu.be/XnIWJyBB0EM?t=2143), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1392), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1818))
- Experts now fade him because of the Achilles. Most would not draft him inside the top 120 and call picks at 83 or 90 too early. One expert says he is fine around picks 100 to 110 in formats that allow stashing. He is called the biggest fade on the Clippers. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=1163), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=1119), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1392), [10-12](https://youtu.be/w66x_I_MaQ8?t=1159), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1818), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1646), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1842), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=1426), [09-29](https://youtu.be/XnIWJyBB0EM?t=2143), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=1714))
- Experts expect him back between Thanksgiving and Christmas, then on minutes limits with rest days. Others say no one knows when he will return or what limits he will have. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1818), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1937), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=1295), [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=4723), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=1714))
- Most experts expect the Clippers to be one of the worst teams. They do not control their own draft pick, so tanking does not help them. (verdict, 2026-10-08; [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=1714), [07-13](https://youtu.be/Rqb5GdrSweY?t=1782), [10-08](https://youtu.be/sDzeYdUhJDI?t=177), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=165), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=2018), [08-22](https://youtu.be/KLogvUwv_d8?t=1267))
- The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks and have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13. (fact, 2026-10-04; [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=2040))
- When healthy, he is projected as a starter and the Clippers' number one option. He and Darius Garland should do nearly everything on offense, and his usage could rise toward 30%. His assists may not rise with Garland on the team. (verdict, 2026-09-17; [08-22](https://youtu.be/KLogvUwv_d8?t=714), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=797), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=904), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=889), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=850))
- He was traded to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard trade. (fact, 2026-08-20; [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=850), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=616), [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=1243))

**Durable**
- Points are his best category. Turnovers are his weakest and high for his position, so a punt TO team loses little with him. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- He has a long injury history, including a partially torn Achilles, and is known as a very slow healer. (fact, 2026-10-12; [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1568), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=1824), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1392), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=502), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=797), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=929))
- He is a strong midrange scorer who needs a lot of the ball and gives little playing off the ball. (verdict, 2026-08-22; [08-22](https://youtu.be/KLogvUwv_d8?t=697), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=262))
- He rarely takes threes and has never committed to higher three-point volume. (fact, 2026-08-22; [08-20](https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk?t=1243), [08-22](https://youtu.be/KLogvUwv_d8?t=697), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=262))
- He is an average defender at best and gives weak defensive stats. (verdict, 2026-08-22; [08-22](https://youtu.be/KLogvUwv_d8?t=697), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=838))
- His games played have swung between 18 and 77 over five seasons, while his minutes stay near 33 when he plays. (fact, 2026-08-09; [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=951))
- Experts have little confidence projecting his games played from year to year. (verdict, 2026-08-09; [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=951), [06-30](https://youtu.be/JMSLg6yz-M0?t=502))

**Tags**
- Current: `injured now` (partially torn Achilles, Yahoo status O; until return, expected Thanksgiving to Christmas), `IL stash` (fine around picks 100 to 110 in stash formats per one expert; others avoid him inside the top 120), `slow start` (out until around Thanksgiving to Christmas, then minutes limits and rest expected), `minutes limit` (expected after his Achilles return), `new team` (traded from Toronto to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard trade), `role up` (likely number one option; usage could rise toward 30%), `bust candidate` (Yahoo rank in the 80s to 90s; experts would not draft him inside the top 120), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo rank 92, ESPN rank 142), `bottom team`, `good playoff schedule` (4-3-4 for a March 28 end), `few back-to-backs` (13 back-to-backs)
- Durable: `injury prone` (partially torn Achilles, slow healer, games played swing widely), `usage dependent` (needs a lot of the ball, little value off the ball), `punt TO fit`

**Note.** Ingram is out with a partially torn Achilles and is expected back between Thanksgiving and Christmas, with minutes limits after that. His Yahoo rank of 92 and 6 USD value are well above what the experts will pay now. He cost 16 USD in our league last season. As a 1 to 3 USD bench pick he is a reasonable stash in a league with 4 IL slots, since he scored 21.5 points in 77 games last season, can be the Clippers' top option, has a good 4-3-4 playoff schedule and suits punt TO builds. Early in the season, check his return date and how quickly the Clippers lift his minutes limit.
